# pinax

> Relational storage engine for the forkwright fleet. Four-crate workspace - lexis and pinax implement Phase 01 (pager / buffer pool / B-tree); hypomnema and phylaxis reserve their workspace position for later phases.

## Architecture

Structured corpus:
- [_llm/architecture.toml](_llm/architecture.toml): planned layers
- [_llm/current_state.toml](_llm/current_state.toml): current phase
- [_llm/decisions.toml](_llm/decisions.toml): locked decisions
